message.content: According to Lachlan, Tyrion Lannister could have shown Cersei a different perspective on power. Lachlan points out that Tyrion always had a different perspective on power, and if Cersei had a stronger bond with him, it could have influenced her decisions. Lachlan suggests that Tyrion’s understanding of power and his ability to see the bigger picture could have helped Cersei make more rational and balanced choices. This relationship, if stronger, would have allowed Cersei to potentially avoid some of the harsh decisions she made throughout the series.
